capabilities: Browse recipes by category and cook them in a step-by-step cooking mode
Scale recipe portions automatically from selected guests' portion weights and dietary restrictions
Build shopping lists that combine ingredients and route them across configured supermarkets and package sizes
Link preparation recipes that produce ingredients used by other recipes
Run parallel cooking timers attached to recipe steps
disambiguation: Not a note-navigation plugin; 'navigator' refers to browsing and stepping through a recipe cookbook.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Recipes and library data are stored as JSON files (cookbook-library.json, recipes-*.json), not Markdown notes; JSON schemas are included. The author warns it is 'not a easy cooking plugin'. Interface supports English and German. Sending shopping lists by email only pre-fills your default email program.
motivation: The author built it to personalize their own cookbook: 'This is my cooking plugin to personalize my cookbooks.'
problem: Obsidian has no built-in recipe management, and static recipes cannot adapt to who is eating, their allergies, or the package sizes actually sold in stores.
summary: Cookbook plugin that stores recipes as JSON and adapts portions, ingredient choices, and shopping lists to guest profiles and store package sizes.
